title: cwb14/LTRquest pipeline parameters
description: Iterative detection of nested LTR retrotransposons

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the genomes come from and where the results go.

input.help_text: One row per genome. `proteins` is optional but strongly recommended, and may come from any related species. Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet's own directory. Sequence IDs must be unique across genomes: pooled clustering keys elements on 'chrom:start-end', so a shared ID would cross-assign families between genomes.

outdir.description: Output directory. May be an S3 URI.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to the output directory.

detection_options.title: Detection options
detection_options.description: How deep to dig, and when to stop.

max_rounds.help_text: Each round exposes one more layer of nesting: 1 finds only un-nested elements, 2 adds elements with one element inside them, and so on. The ceiling is 10 because the detector marks each round with a distinct IUPAC character and has ten to spend.

terminate_count.description: Stop once a round finds fewer than this many elements.
terminate_count.help_text: The loop halts on its own well before --max_rounds on most genomes, because each round finds fewer elements than the last.

fp_mask_threshold.description: False-positive element fraction above which the run is flagged.
fp_mask_threshold.help_text: High-abundance non-LTR repeats can seed convincing but spurious calls. Families that are mostly such repeats are purged from the *_clean_* tables regardless; this threshold governs whether the run is additionally reported as FP-dominated. See docs/nextflow.md.

family_prefix.help_text: All genomes are clustered together in one pass, so `<family_prefix>_fam00001` denotes the same family in every genome's output. That shared vocabulary is what makes between-species family comparisons meaningful.

mutation_rate.description: Neutral substitution rate per site per year.
mutation_rate.help_text: Sets the k2p_time (insertion age) column: k2p / (2 * mutation_rate). Used both for each round's element table and for the pooled family-clustering pass.

min_seq_id.description: Sequence identity threshold for the pooled family-clustering pass.
min_seq_id.help_text: Forwarded to Kmer2LTR's consensus and internal clustering as --min-seq-id. Lower values merge more distant elements into one family.

skip_plots.description: Skip the structure PDFs, summary PDF and TEGV browser.

aws_queue.description: AWS Batch job queue to submit to.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Options that do not affect the results.

help.description: Print the help message and exit.

version.description: Print the pipeline version and exit.
